verdict.rationale: Canva documents exporting designs in multiple widely used formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) through its MCP server. Its Connect APIs and design discovery tools can retrieve and sync designs and assets, so a scripted per-design export path exists. However, nothing shows a full-account or bulk data export, and the formats listed are rendered outputs rather than an open, editable design source format, so leaving with everything intact is only partly supported. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account export, export of editable designs in an open native format, coverage of non-design data (comments, brand kits, folders), independent or hands-on corroboration.
